# Roblox Open Cloud API

A set of REST APIs allowing external services to interact with Roblox resources and assets.

**Link:** https://create.roblox.com

## What creators claimed

- Enables Claude to programmatically upload and configure assets within a Roblox game. ([Dd4_kY-StGS](../reels/Dd4_kY-StGS.md))
